name: dip_scenario_wizard
description: Question tree that routes a business question to one scenario ID. Each option either points to the next question (next) or ends at a scenario (leaf). Leaf nodes carry ONLY scenario_id; the backend annotates status/name/needs from the live registry, so the tree can never drift from the engine.

Q1.text: What type of system are you modelling?

Q2A.text: What do you want the tool to do for this BTM system?

options.label: Verify a design under real operation

Q3A1.text: What kind of fixed-design answer do you need?

options.label: Minimum grid connection for this fixed design

Q3A2.text: What is the main sizing target?

options.label: Both SSR and grid connection together

Q4A2a.text: For SSR sizing, what answer shape do you want?

options.label: One battery size for one SSR target
Full curve across many SSR targets

Q4A2b.text: For grid-connection sizing, what answer shape do you want?

options.label: One battery size for one GC target
Full curve across many GC targets

Q4A2c.text: For joint SSR + GC sizing, is PV size fixed or also solved?

options.label: PV size should also be solved

Q3A3.text: Sizing PV and battery together — which target?

Q4A3.text: For PV + BESS with an SSR target, what answer shape?

Q5A3b.text: For PV + BESS with a grid target, what answer shape?

Q3A4.text: What kind of operational check do you want?

options.label: Verify KPIs for a fixed design under causal operation
Re-size to a deliverable battery under real operation

Q2B.text: What do you want the tool to do for a BESS + Load system?

options.label: Size battery for a grid connection target

Q2C.text: What do you want to solve for an off-grid system?

options.label: Minimum PV + BESS for a firmness target

Q2D.text: What do you want to solve for a standalone generation system?

options.label: Battery size for an export-limited curtailment target
